channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Quin Snyder | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Quin Snyder from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Danny Ainge on Quin Snyder:

“I feel like we have a good relationship that can go on well past this job and this opportunity. I know that he's going to be coaching somewhere else in the near future,next year, probably.”

Danny Ainge on Quin Snyder, Jun 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Greg Miller on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Greg Miller wants to see the franchise succeed whether his family has a hand in it or not.

“As someone who was invested — emotionally and financially invested — in the Jazz for decades, I would love nothing more than to see Ryan and the Jazz, Quin [Snyder], and everyone in the organization, just continue to grow and progress and ultimately win an NBA championship,”

Greg Miller on Quin Snyder, May 19, 2022. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Draymond Green on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Mark Haynes:Draymond Green on Quin Snyder including him in MVP talk:

“I agree with him, and I think that's someone who sees the game for what it is... I don't think it could have been explained any better... The things I do to impact winning, I think there's something to be said for that.”

Draymond Green on Quin Snyder, Jan 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Jordan Clarkson on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Jordan Clarkson, on the message from Quin Snyder:

“We're really just focused on being ourselves, bro. That's offensively and defensively. … Our biggest message is being ourselves and being aggressive and doing what we do.”

Jordan Clarkson on Quin Snyder, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Eric Walden:Steve Clifford on Quin Snyder:

“He’s one of the elite coaches. They’re disciplined. They’re the most balanced team in the NBA.They have a way to play, and he tinkers with it every offseason. Like I said, they’re the most balanced team, and he’s absolutely absolutely elite.”

Steve Clifford on Quin Snyder, Feb 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Eric Walden:Andre Iguodala on the Jazz:

“Coach Snyder is coaching the hell out of that team. They're really efficient on both sides of the ball, and when you play that way, you're going to win more often than not.… We need to have the mentality that we have to defend the whole 24 seconds.”

Andre Iguodala on Quin Snyder, Feb 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas on being nominated for Western Conference Coach of the Month (Utah’s Quin Snyder won it):

“How about that. Pretty cool. Wow. That’s a testament to the players and my assistants.”

Stephen Silas on Quin Snyder, Feb 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Eric Walden:Mike Budenholzer on his former assistant Quin Snyder:

“He’s just such a creative mind — you never know what he’s gonna do.... I love the friendship with Quin and we’ve helped each other grow as coaches.”

Mike Budenholzer on Quin Snyder, Jan 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: George Hill on Dennis Lindsey, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Bucks PG George Hill:

“I love Utah. ... My teammates was an awesome cast to play with. ... I felt like I was going to be here, but it didn’t work out. That’s no knock to the organization, ‘cause they have my utmost respect. Dennis Lindsey and Quin Snyder, I love them to death.”

George Hill on Dennis Lindsey, Quin Snyder, Nov 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Fotis Katsikaris on Vassilis Spanoulis, Quin Snyder
item.description:
confirmed Katsikaris, while speaking to the media on a conference call.

“There are different option and moves, starting with a move under the basket and then with a handoff, something Olympiacos has always done with Spanoulis and coach Snyder has adapted it to his philosophy”

Fotis Katsikaris on Vassilis Spanoulis, Quin Snyder, Oct 30, 2018. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Fotis Katsikaris on Quin Snyder
item.description:
For Katsikaris on a personal level, the move to the NBA is the biggest challenge yet, even if he was a head coach in Europe for 15 years:

“When I received coach Snyder’s invitation, I realized this was my biggest challenge. Apart from the fact that it was my dream to be in the NBA, the time was right for this decision. I felt, of course, like closing a 15-year cycle and starting a new one, of course using my experience but on a different role. That was what I thought, making the decision to do something new, to rejuvenate myself.”

Fotis Katsikaris on Quin Snyder, Oct 30, 2018. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Jeff Van Gundy on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Spencer Checketts:More Jeff Van Gundy:

“I don't think Quin Snyder is a good coach, I think he's a great coach. I think he's an extraordinary coach.”

Jeff Van Gundy on Quin Snyder, May 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @1280Spence.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Gregg Popovich on Quin Snyder's coaching season:

“He's done a decent job. Not that great. Could have done a lot better, I thought.”

Gregg Popovich on Quin Snyder, Apr 12, 2017. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Quin Snyder
item.description:
Spencer Checketts:Stan Van Gundy on Quin Snyder:

“I don't think he's on the way to becoming one of the best coaches in the NBA, I think he IS one of the best in the NBA.”

Stan Van Gundy on Quin Snyder, Jan 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @1280Spence.

item.title: Joe Johnson on Quin Snyder
item.description:
“Me and coach Snyder have talked from time to time through texts or phone calls. He understands where I’m at and I understand what he wants from me as a player and that’s to help these young guyssuch as Rodney (Hood) and Gordon. I’m here to tell them about some of the things I’ve been through and help them out with their experiences.”

Joe Johnson on Quin Snyder, Sep 29, 2016. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Bill Neff on Dennis Lindsey, Gordon Hayward, George Hill, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Neff told The Tribune on Wednesday.

“One, George likes it in Utah. Two, George has a close relationship with Gordon Hayward [both are Indianapolis natives]. Three, [Jazz general manager] Dennis Lindsey was largely responsible for bringing George to San Antonio. George has worked with [Jazz coach] Quin Snyder. This is one of the teams George has always wanted to play for.”

Bill Neff on Dennis Lindsey, Gordon Hayward, George Hill, Quin Snyder, Jun 22, 2016. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Gail Miller on Quin Snyder
item.description:
“With this contract extension, we are declaring our confidence in Coach Snyder’s ability to continue to develop the Utah Jazz into a championship team,”

Gail Miller on Quin Snyder, May 6, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Shelvin Mack, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Jazz GM Dennis Lindsey:

“We have very good corporate knowledge of Shelvin (Mack). Quin (Snyder) was a big proponent of this acquisition.”

Dennis Lindsey on Shelvin Mack, Quin Snyder, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: Larry Brown on Billy King, Quin Snyder
item.description:
“I tried to recruit Tommy, Billy King, Quin Snyder, a lot of them. But when (Amaker) was at Michigan, he let me come and hang out at his practices, so this is more of the same. I’m going to (Kansas) next week. I’ve been speaking a lot — Villanova and Rutgers. I hang out in Philadelphia, so I’ve been at Villanova a lot.”

Larry Brown on Billy King, Quin Snyder, Oct 28, 2011. Source: Boston Herald.
